author: UrielHismar
quote: This s****y game has the audacity to be locked at 30 fps in 2026, and it only gets away with it because of its name. Anyone giving this a 10/10 has lost their mind—they’re asking for $80 to $100, yet the experience isn’t even smooth. Worse yet, out of pure greed, they’re withholding a PC release just to push their $80 game onto a six-year-old console. Go **** yourselves, "BOKstar" [S***-star]. *Ocarina of Time*—even as a remake—is packed with detail and supports 60 fps; it’s a fantastic game. Good luck to anyone willing to pay $100 for this 24-fps, eye-torturing experience. And as for the fanboys attacking us just because we want a better experience—go to h***.
